goal: Create a network scanning tool that can scan ports on hosts and generate a JSON report of open ports and services.
acceptance_criteria: The scanner must accept IP addresses or hostnames with CIDR notation
The scanner must support port ranges and individual ports
The scanner must handle timeouts gracefully
The scanner must output results in JSON format
All socket operations must be properly closed to prevent ResourceWarnings
Input validation for hosts and ports is implemented
Logging is implemented for debugging and progress tracking
